chain.title: Bones in the Bedrock
chain.desc: Dropped by Stone and Deepslate Fossil ore; the Mesozoic Fossil is the raw feedstock of the whole extraction line.

chain.title: Field Notes on the Dead
chain.desc: Any fossil plus a book. The Encyclopedia of Prehistory indexes 31 creatures and 14 plants with their diets and habitats.

chain.title: Empty Glass, Waiting
chain.desc: Five glass in a U shape yields three Flasks; the Analyzer cannot be built without one.

chain.title: Read What the Stone Remembers
chain.desc: Iron, copper, a Redstone Block and a Flask. It breaks fossils down into DNA Flasks on a weighted random table.

chain.title: Older Than the Dinosaurs
chain.desc: The Paleozoic Fossil from Deepslate Fossil ore, holding the mod's oldest and strangest genomes.

chain.title: The Tyrant, Bottled
chain.desc: One of 45 DNA Flasks the Analyzer can produce; this one carries Tyrannosaurus Rex.

chain.title: Primordial Sludge
chain.desc: The growth medium the Cultivator runs on, and the part of the machine you cannot buy with metal.

chain.title: Coax the Cells to Divide
chain.desc: Iron, copper, glass, a Redstone Block and Organic Ooze. It turns a DNA Flask into an egg, a sapling or an embryo.

chain.title: Keep the Samples Cold
chain.desc: Copper, iron, blue ice and an Encrusted Organ; bulk storage for a growing flask collection.

chain.title: The Clutch You Should Not Have Made
chain.desc: The Cultivator's output for Rex DNA; one of 22 egg items that hatch into live prehistoric animals.

chain.title: Trapped in Golden Resin
chain.desc: Mined from Amber Ore; feeding it to the Analyzer yields the insect-borne genomes.

chain.title: A Chunk of Frozen Sunlight
chain.desc: The Amber Chunk dropped alongside the fossil, and the base of the mod's amber blocks and glass.

chain.title: Bone Turned to Rainbow
chain.desc: From Opal Ore. Opalised remains carry genomes the ordinary rock never preserved.

chain.title: Locked in the Permafrost
chain.desc: Broken out of Permafrost Fossil Ore; it must be thawed by cooking before the Analyzer will read it.

chain.title: Something Is Moving Inside
chain.desc: Grown in the Cultivator from Encrusted DNA, and the only way to get an Encrusted Organ.

chain.title: Still-Living Tissue
chain.desc: Harvested from the Encrusted; both the Incubator and the DNA Fridge are built around one.

chain.title: Pelt of the Sabre-Tooth
chain.desc: Taken from Smilodon and spun with magma cream and wool into the Insulator.

chain.title: Hold the Warmth In
chain.desc: Smilodon Fur, magma cream and light blue wool; the Incubator needs two and the Dino Pouch needs two more.

chain.title: A Womb Built From Copper
chain.desc: Insulators, copper, an Encrusted Organ, Organic Ooze and lime glass. Mammal embryos will only grow inside it.

chain.title: The Tundra, Reassembled
chain.desc: The Cultivator's output for Mammoth DNA; one of six embryos that the Incubator hatches directly into a live calf.

chain.title: Carry the Beast Home
chain.desc: Leather, string and two Insulators, for moving a creature without herding it.

chain.title: Stand Before the Tyrant
chain.desc: Tyrannosaurus Rex is the mod's apex predator and spawns naturally as well as hatching from a Rex Egg.

chain.title: Wear What You Killed
chain.desc: Crafted from the Rex's remains; the trophy at the top of the mod's gear tree.

chain.title: Armour of Cast-Off Scales
chain.desc: The Shedscale Wraps, built from scales the mod's reptiles shed as they grow.

notes: VERIFICATION: 316 ids pass models/item INTERSECT lang, the cleanest of the five jars - only 10 model stems fell outside it and every one is a render-only variant (ammonite_shell_icon, fruit_loot_box, *_in_hand held models, *_blocking shield poses, clathrodictyon_wall_fan and its dead twin), none registry-referenced. ENTITIES: this is the jar the warning was about. 53 entity.unusualprehistory.* lang keys reduce to 50 real candidates after removing the three all.command_* tooltip keys, and only 31 are verified against a registry source - data/unusualprehistory/loot_tables/entities/, the 48 Forge biome_modifier spawn entries, and the 40 mod advancements. DROPPED 19 that would have produced uncompletable or nonsensical kill tasks: 4 projectiles/parts (amber_shot, hwacha_spike, opalescent_pearl, opalescent_shuriken, palaeophis_part), iceberg_mammoth and iceberg_smilodon (frozen structure props whose loot tables live at the different paths iceberg/mammoth and iceberg/smilodon), brachi_teen, and the 12 baby_* forms. IMPORTANT CORRECTION on the babies: 6 of them ARE registered and are provable - the unusualprehistory:incubating recipes output them as bare entity id strings (giganto_embryo -> unusualprehistory:baby_giganto, and the same for baby_mammoth, baby_megatherium, baby_palaophis, baby_paracer, baby_smilodon). They are left out of the chain deliberately, because they grow into the adults and a kill task on a hatchling you just incubated is bad questing, not because they are unverifiable. GRAPH: the spine is fossil -> Analyzer (unusualprehistory:analyzing, 14 recipes) -> DNA Flask -> Cultivator (unusualprehistory:cultivator, 45 recipes) -> egg / sapling / embryo, and for the six mammals a further Incubator step (unusualprehistory:incubating, 6 recipes) -> live baby. Analyzer recipes declare only an input; the flask you get is rolled in code, so no specific fossil maps to a specific flask. 45 flasks but only 22 eggs and 6 embryos, because the plant genomes produce saplings instead. CONSENSUS CONFLICT (graph preferred): all 26 moddb ids exist, but moddb places 11 egg and embryo items at pos 0.0-0.16 (megala_eggs and palaeo_flask at 0.0, kentro_eggs 0.032, talpanas_egg 0.065, scau_eggs 0.097, trike_eggs 0.129, paracer_embryo 0.161) while ranking cultivator at 0.200 - yet the recipe graph is unambiguous that every egg and embryo is an OUTPUT of the Cultivator and therefore cannot precede it. The graph ordering is used: flask -> analyzer -> DNA -> cultivator -> eggs. moddb's placement of palaeo_flask at 0.0 is consistent with the graph and is kept, since flasks come from the Analyzer, one machine earlier.
